# Monsha

> Monsha is an AI-powered lesson planning and classroom resource generation platform designed to help K-12 educators create standards-aligned curricula, assessments, and teaching materials in minutes.

Monsha provides teachers with AI tools for lesson planning, quiz generation, worksheet creation, and custom resource development. The platform integrates with Google Workspace and other LMS tools, offers flexible pricing for individual teachers and schools, and includes professional development resources and certification courses for educators adopting AI in the classroom.

## Key Topics

- AI lesson planning
- Curriculum planning
- Resource creation
- Differentiation
- Teacher tools
- Classroom materials
- Standards alignment

- ChatGPT prompts
- K-12 education

## Core Tools

- [Lesson Plan Generator](https://monsha.ai/tools/lesson-plan-generator): AI-powered lesson plan generator with customization and standards alignment features
- [Quiz Questions Generator](https://monsha.ai/tools/questions-generator): AI quiz and assessment question generator with customizable difficulty and standards
- [Image Generator](https://monsha.ai/tools/image-generator): AI image generator for classroom-ready illustrations, diagrams, and teaching visuals
- [Create Anything](https://monsha.ai/tools/create-anything): Monsha tool for generating custom teaching resources, feedback, and classroom materials

## Getting Started

- [Monsha Homepage](https://monsha.ai): Monsha homepage: AI-powered lesson planning and classroom resource generation for educators
- [AI Tools for Teachers](https://monsha.ai/ai-tools-for-teachers): Overview of Monsha's AI tools for creating lesson plans, presentations, quizzes, worksheets
- [Free Demo](https://monsha.ai/demo): Book free 30-day trial demo of Monsha for lesson planning and curriculum building
- [Pricing](https://monsha.ai/pricing): Monsha pricing plans: free tier and Pro plan with 14-day free trial

## School & District Solutions

- [Monsha for Schools and Districts](https://monsha.ai/schools): School and district licensing options with bulk purchasing and team collaboration features
- [Request a Quote](https://monsha.ai/quote-request): Request custom quotes for school licenses, bulk pricing, and pilot programs
- [Nominate Your School](https://monsha.ai/nominate-your-school): School and district referral program to introduce Monsha to education leaders

## Professional Development & Learning

- [AI Courses for Teachers](https://monsha.ai/ai-courses-for-teachers): Free certification courses in AI for educators and Monsha tool mastery
- [Request a Free PD Session](https://monsha.ai/invite-for-pd): Request free AI professional development workshops and webinars for teacher training
- [Professional Development Decks](https://monsha.ai/professional-development-decks): Customizable PD slide decks for teacher training on Monsha and AI in education
- [Webinars](https://monsha.ai/webinars): Live webinars with product demos, updates, and Q&A sessions for educators
